posts.author: Meganodark
posts.body: Well, i wanted a animation of a toss coin for an attack on rpg maker mz, but, idk how use effekseer, and following a tutorial i made this animation. I saved the path for the same folder on the project, but the animation doens't play on mz. Well, if anyone can me explain what i doing wrong, i will be happy and gratefull. If anyone wants to make a aimation, the files are attached.

posts.author: Niniann
posts.body:
Greetings,
When you created the animation, did you save it from effekseer directly into your game's effects folder?
If you saved it somewhere else, and then moved it to your game's effects folder, that often will break the animation, because the filepaths for textures and models will not be correct.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Oh, I have flipping coin animations ready to use, if you want, but... They are not effekseer made. Instead they are made for the traditional RPG maker 2D system.
I believe this can also be used in MZ nowadays, but I don't know if this can be used in MZ while other animations still use effekseer.
I bet you can get your own to work, with some help. If not, you could use mine and try if it works with in combination with the effekseer animations.
